choices.content: Real numbers correspond one-to-one with points on the number line.
All points on the number line represent rational numbers.
Real numbers are divided into two categories: positive real numbers and negative real numbers.

question.prompt: Which of the following statements is correct?

solutions.explanation: Points on the number line represent both rational and irrational numbers, and real numbers correspond one-to-one with points on the number line. Real numbers are divided into three categories: positive real numbers, \(0\), and negative real numbers. \(0\) is rational.
solutions.title: Real numbers and number-line points
